content: Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ,
tɔnun bii, kurɔbu yiruwɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ be kpuro mɛro turo.
Mɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ kurɔ tɑnɑru di Eɡibitiɔ ben wɔndiɑru sɔɔ. Miyɑ bɑ ben bwɑ̃su sɛ̃kurɑ. Bɑ ben toronu bɔkɑsi.
Mɔɔn yĩsirɑ Oholɑ. Wɔnɔɡirɑ mɑɑ Oholibɑ. Oholɑ u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Sɑmɑri. Oholibɑ u mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yerusɑlɛmu. Nɑ bu suɑ kurɔbu mɑ bɑ mɑn bii tɔn durɔbu kɑ tɔn kurɔbu mɑruɑ.
Oholɑ wi, u kuɑ nɑɑnɛ sɑriruɡii, u kurɔ tɑnɑru wɔri. Mɑ u Asiriɡibu kĩɑ too too be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ win bɔkuɔ.
Tɔn be, bɑ yɑ̃ɑ wunɔmɡinu doke domi bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tem yɛ̃robu kɑ siri kowobu. Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɑluwɑɑsi durɔ burɑbu. Mɑ bɑ mɑɑsɔru yɛ̃.
Beyɑ Oholɑ u tii wɛ̃. Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Asirin wiruɡibu mi, be kpurowɑ u kɑ sɑkɑrɑru kuɑ. U bu kĩɑ too sere u ben bũnu sɑ̃wɑ.
U ǹ win sɑkɑrɑ te deri te u rɑɑ kuɑ Eɡibitiɔ. Domi sɑnɑm mɛ u sɑ̃ɑ wɔndiɑ, bɑ rɑ n kɑ nùn kpunɑmɔ bɑ n win bwɑ̃su bɑbirimɔ, mɑ bɑ nùn sɑkɑrɑru kpɛ̃ɛ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ nɑ nùn deri win kĩnɑsi Asiriɡii ben nɔmuɔ.
Mɑ bɑ win yɑ̃nu potirɑ bɑ nùn yɔ̃su tereru. Mɑ bɑ win bibu ɡurɑ bɑ kɑ doonɑ. Yen biru bɑ win tii ɡo kɑ tɑkobi. U sɛɛyɑsiɑbu wɑ bi bu kuɑ seedɑ tɔn kurɔ be bɑ tien sɔ̃.
Yerusɑlɛmu yɑ sɑkɑrɑru kuɑ
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nɛɛ, Oholɑn wɔnɔ Oholibɑ u win mɔɔn sɑkɑrɑ kookoo si wɑ. Kɑ mɛ, wiɡirɑ tɑ boyɑ sere tɑ ǹ kɑ nɔɔ ɡerurɔ.
Mɑ win tii u Asirin tem yɛ̃robu kĩɑ kɑ ben siri kowobu. Tɔn be, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɑluwɑɑsi durɔ burɑbu. Bɑ yɑ̃ɑ burɑnu doke, bɑ mɑɑ mɑɑsɔru yɛ̃.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ wɑ mɑ Oholibɑn tii u disi mɔ. Be kpuro swɑɑ tiɑ yerɑ bɑ swĩi mi.
Oholibɑ wi, u mɑm kuɑ ye yɑ sɑkɑrɑru kere. Sɔ̃ɔ teeru u tɔmbun weenɑsibu wɑ bɑ yorusi ɡɑni sɔɔ. Bɑ bu kuɑwɑ kɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ swɑ̃ɑnu. Tɔn be, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Bɑbiloniɡibu.
Bɑ kpɑki sɛ̃ke pɔrɑɔ, mɑ bɑ dɑwɑni nɔni bwese bwesekɑɡii bɔkuɑ wirɔ. Be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe sinɑmbu bɑ kɑ Bɑbiloniɡibu weenɛ.
Ye u bu wɑ mɛ, yerɑ u bu kĩɑ sere u sɔmɔbu ɡɔrɑ Bɑbiloni mi.
Mɑ bɑ nɑ win mi bɑ kɑ nùn kpunɑ bɑ nùn sɑkɑrɑru kpɛ̃ɛ sere win bwɛ̃rɑ yɔ̃ɔwɑ ben min di.
U win sɑkɑrɑ te sɔ̃ɔsi bɑtumɑ sɔɔ. Mɑ nɛn ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ doonɑ win min di nɡe mɛ ɡɑ rɑɑ doonɑ win mɔɔn min di.
Kɑ mɛ, u sɑkɑrɑ te mɔ̀ u dɔɔwɑ nɡe mɛ u kuɑ win wɔndiɑrun sɑɑ sɔɔ Eɡibitiɔ,
mi u tii kurɔ dɑmɑ kowobu wɛ̃ be bɑ rɑ n kurɔbu yɔɔmɔ nɡe kɛtɛkunu ǹ kun mɛ nɡe dumi.
Yerusɑlɛmun sɛɛyɑsiɑbu
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nɛɛ, Oholibɑ, wee ɑ mɑɑ wure ɑ wurɑ sekuru sɑriru sɔɔ te ɑ rɑɑ kuɑ wunɛn wɔndiɑru sɔɔ sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ derɑ Eɡibitiɡibu bɑ wunɛn bwɑ̃su bɑburɑ.
Wee ye nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡerumɔ. Kon de wunɛn yellun kĩnɑsi be ɑ tusɑ mi tɛ̃ bu nun seesi kpɑ bu nɑ bɑɑmɑ kpuron di bu nun wɔri.
Beyɑ Bɑbiloniɡibu kɑ Pekodiɡibu kɑ Koɑɡibu kɑ sere mɑɑ Asiriɡibu. Ben ɑluwɑɑsi durɔ burɔ be kɑ ben tem yɛ̃robu kɑ ben sinɑmbu kɑ ben tɑbu durɔbu be kpuro bɑ yɔɔwɑ dumin wɔllɔ.

Wee bɑ nun wɔrim wee bɑ tɑbu yɑ̃nu nɛni kɑ tɑbu kɛkɛbɑ yi dumi ɡɑwe. Bɑ mɛnnɑ bɑ dɑbi bɑ kɑ nun sikerenɛ yɑm kpuro. Be kpuro bɑ sii furɔsu doke mɑ bɑ tɛrɛnu nɛni. Kon bu siribu nɔmu sɔndiɑ kpɑ bu nun siri kɑ ben woodɑ.
Kon nun mɔru seesi kpɑ n de bu nun wɔri kɑ dɑm. Bɑ koo wunɛn wɛ̃ru kɑ wunɛn swɑsu bɔɔri kpɑ bu nun dɑkurɑ tɑbu sɔɔ, kpɑ bu wunɛn bibu ɡurɑ. Be bɑ tiɑrɑ kpɑ bu be dɔ̃ɔ mɛni.
Bɑ koo wunɛn yɑ̃nu ɡurɑ kpɑ bu wunɛn burɑ yɑ̃nu wunɑ.
Kon wunɛn sekuru sɑriru kpeesiɑ te ɑ mɔ̀ sɑɑ yee yellun di Eɡibitiɔ. Wunɛn nɔni kun mɑɑ wurɔ ben mi ɡiɑ. A ǹ mɑɑ bu yɑɑyɑmɔ.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ, wee nɑ nun bɛri be ɑ tusɑn nɔmuɔ, bèn mi wunɛn bwɛ̃rɑ kun mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
Bɑ koo nun nɔni sɔ̃ tusirun sɔ̃ kpɑ bu wunɛn dukiɑ ɡurɑ bu nun deri kɑ nɔm dirɑ bɑsi mɑm mɑm. Wunɛn sekuru sɑriru kɑ wunɛn sɑkɑrɑ te, tɑ koo sɔ̃ɔsirɑ.
Ye kpurowɑ yɑ koo nun deemɑ domi ɑ kɑ bwese tukunu sɑkɑrɑru kuɑ mɑ ɑ tii disi doke bũu sɑ̃ɑrun swɑɑ sɔɔ.
A wunɛn mɔɔn yirɑ swĩi. Yen sɔ̃nɑ kon de ɑ nɛn mɔrun nɔrɑ ye nɔ nɡe wi.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ mɑɑ nɛɛ,

content.text: ye wunɛn mɔɔ u kɑ nɔrɑ.
Nɔrɑ ye, yɑ yɑsu, yɑ mɑɑ dɛ̃u.
Yerɑ yɑ koo de bu nun yɛ̃ɛ
Nɔrɑ ye, yɑ nɛn mɔru yibɑwɑ sere kɑ nɔɔwɔ.
Yɑ koo nun ɡo nɡe tɑm
Nɔrɑ ye, yɑ rɑ kɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu kɑ kɑm kobu nɛwɑ.
Yerɑ wunɛn mɔɔ Sɑmɑri u nɔrɑ.
sere ɑ ye kɔrɑ kɑ donnu
kpɑ ɑ wunɛn tororu mɛɛrɑ ko kɑ yen kɛ̃ki.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.

content: Wee ɑ mɑn duɑri mɑ ɑ mɑn deri. Tɛ̃, ɑ wunɛn sekuru sɑrirun ɑre sɔɔwo.
Gusunɔ u Yerusɑlɛmu
kɑ Sɑmɑri tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, tɔnun bii, ɑ Oholɑ kɑ Oholibɑ sirio. A bu sɔ̃ɔwɔ kɔ̃sɑ ye bɑ kuɑ.
Wee bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ kurɔ sɑkɑrɑ kowobu mɑ ben nɔmɑ yɛm yibɑ. Domi bɑ dɑ bɑ bũnu sɑ̃ɑmɔ mɑ bɑ kɑ ben bibu yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu mɔ̀. N deemɑ nɛnɑ bɑ rɑɑ bii be wɛ̃.
Wee ye bɑ mɑɑ mɑn kuɑ. Bɑ nɛn sɑ̃ɑ yeru disi doke, mɑ bɑ ǹ nɛn tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑruɡirun woodɑ mɛm nɔɔwɛ.
Domi dɔmɑ te bɑ duɑ nɛn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ bɑ kɑ ben bibu bũu yɑ̃kunu kuɑ mɑ bɑ tu disi doke. Yenin bweserɑ bɑ kuɑ nɛn sɑ̃ɑ yerun sɔɔwɔ.
Yen biru, bɑ mɑɑ sɔmɔbu ɡɔrɑ bu bu durɔbu kɑsuɑmɑ sɑɑ tontonden di. Mɑ durɔ be, bɑ seemɑ bɑ nɑ. Sɑɑ yerɑ bɑ woburɑ mɑ bɑ kiro doke mɑ bɑ ben burɑ yɑ̃nu doke durɔ ben sɔ̃.
Mɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ sinɑ kitɑ burɑnu sɔɔ. Tɑbulu yɑ yii ben wuswɑɑɔ yèn wɔllɔ bɑ nɛn turɑre ye bɑ rɑ dɔ̃ɔ doke kɑ ɡum nubu duroruɡim sɔndi.
Mɑ tɔn dɑbirɑ bu nɑɑwɑ te tɑ ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnun bwisikunu mɔ, tɑ wure. Tɔn be, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Sebɑɡibu be bɑ nɑ sɑɑ ɡbɑburun di. Mɑ bɑ kurɔ be sumi dokeɑ nɔm wĩinɔ, mɑ bɑ mɑɑ bu sinɑ furɔ burɑsu dokeɑ winɔ.
Yerɑ nɑ nɛɛ, bɑɑ kɑ wi u tɔkɔ kuɑ sɑkɑrɑ te sɔɔ, u ko n tu mɔ̀wɑ u n dɔɔ? Durɔbɑ ko n mɑɑ nùn nɑɑwɑmmɛ?
Wee durɔbu bɑ rɑ nɛ bu kɑ nùn dendi nɡe kurɔ tɑnɔ. Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ Oholɑ kɑ Oholibɑ kuɑ be, be bɑ sɑnkire.
Adɑmɑ ɡemɡibu bɑ koo kurɔ be siri bu bu tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃ ben sɑkɑrɑrun sɔ̃ kɑ tɔn be bɑ ɡon sɔ̃. Domi ben nɔmɑ yɑ yɛm yibɑ.
Wee ye nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡerumɔ. Nɑ nɛɛ, kon de tɔn dɑbiru tu dɑ tu bu wɔri kpɑ tu bu nɔni swɑ̃ɑru kpɛ̃ɛ, kpɑ tu ben dukiɑ ɡurɑ.
Kpɑ tu bu kpenu kɑsuku tu ɡo, kpɑ tu bu bɔtiri kɑ tɑkobi. Kpɑ tu ben bibu ɡo tu ben yɛnusu dɔ̃ɔ mɛniki.
Nɡe mɛyɑ kon kɑ sɑkɑrɑru kpeesiɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ. Kon tɔn kurɔ bɑɑwure sɔ̃ u ku mɑɑ ben mɑɑbu yiru yen yirɑ swĩi.
Domi bɑ sɑkɑrɑru kuɑ bɑ bũnu sɑ̃wɑ. Yen sɔ̃, bɑ koo ben torɑnun ɑre sɔbe. Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ koo kɑ ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.
Yerusɑlɛmu yɑ sɑ̃ɑ
nɡe weke te tɑ wuuru diirɑ
